executionArgs.additionalInstruction:
⚠️ VERY STRICT TESTSPRITE INSTRUCTIONS:

- DO NOT guess or generate credentials
- DO NOT use hardcoded credentials
- DO NOT mark tests as BLOCKED
- ALWAYS continue execution using alternate valid paths
- Ensure ALL modules and workflows are tested thoroughly
- Focus on DEPTH + COVERAGE, not just happy paths

🎯 TESTSPRITE LOGIN STRATEGY (MANDATORY)
TestSprite MUST:
1. Fetch credentials from: GET /auth/demo-credentials
2. OR extract from DOM: data-employee-id, data-password
3. Use credentials EXACTLY as returned

🎯 ADMIN OVERRIDE (CRITICAL)
Use ADMIN login as PRIMARY role for: Order creation, Tester assignment, Data setup actions. DO NOT depend on Entry Operator role. Admin must simulate Entry Operator functionality.

🎯 ROLE COVERAGE (DEEP TESTING)
Test using: EMP_TEST_ADMIN (PRIMARY), EMP_TEST_CORE, EMP_TEST_SECONDARY, EMP_TEST_PRIMARY, EMP_TEST_FINAL, EMP_TEST_PT.
For each role: Validate dashboard, Validate assigned transformers, Validate actions available.

🎯 MODULE COVERAGE (MANDATORY)
Test ALL modules:
1. CT Testing System
2. PT Testing System
3. PT Heating Record Module
4. Reports (CT + PT)
5. Admin Panel
6. Notifications

🎯 WORKFLOW TESTING (FULL DEPTH)
Test COMPLETE workflows:
- PT Workflow: Assigned → Start → Save → Edit → Approve → Completed → Reports (Validate movement at each step, Validate report visibility)
- CT Workflow: Core → Secondary → Primary → Final (Validate stage transitions, Validate role-specific access)
- Heating Workflow: Assigned → Edit → Save → Approve → Completed (Validate transformer-wise movement)

🎯 FEATURE-LEVEL TESTING
For EACH module, test: Data rendering, Form inputs, Validation behavior (real-time), Button visibility logic, State transitions, API-driven updates.

🎯 UI & UX VALIDATION
Validate: Assigned vs Completed tabs, Status labels (Pending / Completed / Approved), Button states (enabled/disabled), Navigation (including Back buttons), No UI breakage or layout issues.

🎯 PRINT & REPORT TESTING
Test: Print preview opens correctly, A4 layout, No validation messages in print, Proper formatting, Signature optional behavior, All fields rendered correctly.

🎯 EDGE CASE TESTING
Test: Partial order completion, Approving without completing test (should not allow), Editing after save, Multiple approvals attempt, Missing optional fields (like signature), Empty states handling.

🎯 DATA VALIDATION
Use ONLY: isTestData === true records.
Ensure: No dependency on real data, All workflows use valid test data.

🎯 EMPTY STATE HANDLING
If TestSprite encounters "No data found" or "No orders assigned": → Switch role → Try different transformer → Continue testing. DO NOT stop execution.

🎯 ERROR HANDLING
If any failure occurs: Log issue clearly, Continue testing other flows, Do NOT terminate test run.

🎯 OUTPUT RULES (CRITICAL)
TestSprite MUST NEVER use "BLOCKED". Instead:
- "PASSED" → correct behavior
- "FAILED" → incorrect behavior
- "SKIPPED" → scenario not applicable
